'''Profoggs''' were small [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] that were native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They possessed a forked tail, sharp [[Tooth/Legends|incisors]], horns, and powerful digging claws.

[[File:Profogg-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A profogg den]]

Builders of complicated underground "towns", these rodents were the scourge of many an [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]] rider, who were often thrown to the ground when their mount stumbled over a hole.

Each profogg town could span several hectares, and contain 50 to 100 profoggs, with each compartmentalized burrow serving a specific function to the community (i.e. nursery, food storage, etc.). The biomass of these complexes was often quite high, as each individual weighed between 10 and 25 kilograms. Due to a high birthrate (6-8 young per litter, 6-8 litters per year) there was a healthy population of the creatures throughout the wilderness. Empty burrows would often be colonized by [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]], [[ibian]]s, and [[kreetle]]s. Profoggs were often the prey of [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]], and [[Scurrier/Legends|scurriers]] would often steal food from profogg towns. A major source of food for profoggs were [[molo seed]]s, but they also had a penchant for raiding [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] gardens. The farmers often set off stink capsules to discourage them.
